buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support.

6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TENDER NOTES 1. Bidder/OEM must not be blacklisted. 2. Authorized dealer responsible for warranty services. 3. Security : User access/security controls and software update facility should be available. 4. Software : Interactive whiteboard/annotation software with writing, erasing, shapes, saving and screen-s haring features. 5. Accessories : Stylus/pens, remote control, power cable and required standard accessories to be supplied . 6. Installation : Complete installation, configuration, testing and commissioning at site shall be the respons ibility of the bidder. 7. Training : Basic operational training shall be provided to nominated users/operators for 02 days. 8. Warranty : Minimum 3 years comprehensive onsite warranty may be specified, including panel, touch sy stem and supplied accessories. 9. After-Sales Support: Bidder/OEM should provide technical support and timely resolution of complaints d uring the warranty period. 10. Demonstration: The purchaser may require a product demonstration before technical evaluation / acce ptance. 11. Acceptance Testing: Final acceptance shall be subject to successful installation, testing and demonstra tion of all specified functions. 12. Documentation: User manual, warranty certificate, technical datasheet and necessary software/license documentation shall be provided. 13. Make in India/Local Content: Wherever applicable, bidder shall comply with prevailing government of I ndia procurement and local-content requirements. MANDATORY QUALIFICATION DOCUMENTS Doc-1- Bidder shall submit a self-attested copy of valid PAN Card with the Bid Doc-2- Aadhaar Card- Bidder/Authorized Signatory shall submit a self attested copy of Aadhaar Card along with the bid Doc-3- GST Registration- Bidder Shall submit a valid GST registration certificate Doc-4- GST return- bidder shall submit relevant GST return document Doc-5- ITR- Bidder Shall submit income tax return of last 3 years

Doc-6- Experience Certificate - Bidder shall submit documentary proof of supply/ experience as specified in the bid Doc-7 Turn over- Bidder shall submit CA certified turnover documents for the specified financial years, whe rever applicable Doc-8- Bidder shall submit an undertaking confirming that all documents/ information submitted with the b id are true and correct. Doc-9- Udyam Certificate- Bidder shall submit Valid Udyam registration certificate as documentary proof of MSE status with the Bid, wherever applicable Doc-10 OEM or Authorized Dealer/Distributor Doc- 11- OEM Product Datasheet / Technical Brochure -clearly mentioning the offered model number and t echnical specifications. Doc-12 Test Reports/Certificates, wherever applicable, for display, electrical safety and electromagnetic c ompatibility. Doc-13 OEM Warranty Certificate/Undertaking for the specified comprehensive onsite warranty. .
